title: Machine Learning-Based Bitcoin Trading Under Transaction Costs: Evidence From Walk-Forward Forecasting

data_binding.reason: shared benchmark data replaces the paper's native dataset and protocol

requirements: Hourly BTC/USDT closing prices and OHLCV data covering 1 December 2017 to 1 January 2026
Cleaned sample must contain 70,872 hourly observations
December 2017 is used as burn-in for rolling feature construction
Effective walk-forward modelling window begins on 1 January 2018 and contains 70,128 observations after burn-in

dimensions.implication: The benchmark uses a frozen shared dataset rather than the paper's original data.
A changed information interval alters the empirical claim.
Only an explicitly named MethodCard model branch may enter the benchmark.
